verdict.rationale: Motion has a live REST API that requires an X-API-Key, but nothing in the evidence shows API keys can be scoped, restricted, or issued with least privilege for an agent. The pricing line 'Permissions & Access Control' is an adjacent workspace feature, not scoped credentials, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
